QUOTE: The library spawns no threads. The four spawn sites the index found are all in `programs/`... Every mutex use in `library/` sits behind `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`. That includes `threading.c` itself... The lock functions are function pointers (`threading.c`), defaulting to pthread. `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` replaces them.

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the library spawns no threads, and that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction (threading.c with pluggable lock function pointers, global mutexes) for threaded callers.
